ruleDefinitions.name: Potential RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.EXE Abuse - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell module creation where the module Contents are set to "function Get-VMRemoteFXPhysicalVideoAdapter". This could be a sign of potential abuse of the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary which is known to be vulnerable to module load-order hijacking. Note: Unmapped fields: Payload
